verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Bun verifying fetched packages against integrity checksums, registry signatures, or provenance attestations. The related features are adjacent controls rather than verification: blocking lifecycle scripts unless trusted, `--frozen-lockfile` for exact-version reproducibility, and `bun audit` for advisory lookups. Package managers can ship this kind of integrity check, so the axis applies; the lack of evidence makes this "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can trust that fetched packages are verified against checksums, signatures, or attestations before they run
